bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'WSL_MNT='; ls -1 /mnt | tr '\n' ','; echo
printf 'GSERVER_ROOT_ITEMS='; ls -1 /home/gace/Project/Gserver | head -30 | tr '\n' ','; echo
printf 'G_DRIVE_PATH_PROBES:\n'
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /mnt/Gdrive /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage /home/gace/Project/Gserver/data /home/gace/Project/Gserver/Gdrive; do if test -d "$p"; then echo "EXISTS $p"; fi; done
printf 'DISK_MOUNTS:\n'
findmnt -rn -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE | grep -E '/mnt/|/media/|/home/gace/Project/Gserver' | head -25 || true
printf 'GSERVER_STORAGE_KEYWORDS:\n'
grep -RInE -m 4 'Gドライブ|G:|/mnt/g|storage_root' /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository/docs 2>/dev/null | head -15 || true
